description: Locale-aware alias LAYER core: grow the AliasTable entry with an optional localisation key (Task 11.1), build the on-disk per-locale/per-environment alias-catalogue reader wired into construction + the ui.locale reload (Task 11.2), and auto-synthesise editable identity rows for every root command, overlay-replaceable without changing the root (Task 11.3). This establishes the shell-owned, locale-overlaid per-environment alias store that FEAT-002's resolver and menu render read. Depends only on STEP 0 (approved docs present in the worktree). ASCII-only; TDD; agent COMPILE-ONLY scoped verification.
steps: STEP 0 (BLOCKING, do first): the approved CR-NR-109 gate artifacts are uncommitted in the MAIN checkout and absent from the worktree. Task 11.1 -- in crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/environment.rs change AliasTable entries from Vec<(String,String)> to Vec<AliasEntry { surface, canonical, localisation_key: Option<String> }> (module-private). Keep canonical_verb and apply_locale_overlay signatures working for existing (surface,canonical) callers by defaulting localisation_key=None internally; add a keyed overlay entry point apply_locale_overlay_keyed(env, &[(String,String,Option<String>)]) reusing the SAME scratch-copy collision machinery. ffedit_english() builds entries with localisation_key=None so en is byte-identical. Add a display-surface accessor returning ff_i18n::t(key) when localisation_key is Some, else the raw surface.

Task 11.1 test FIRST (environment.rs #[cfg(test)]): display_surface_resolves_localisation_key_else_raw_surface with // Validates: localization Requirement 11.1, 11.2 -- install a tiny test catalogue (verb-find = SOEK), build an entry (surface=FIND, canonical=FIND, localisation_key=Some(verb-find)), assert display surface is 'SOEK' and a None-key entry returns its raw surface; after a keyed overlay, canonical_verb('SOEK') resolves to 'FIND' (one source of truth, Req 11.2).

Task 11.2 -- add a NEW module crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/alias_reader.rs (register mod alias_reader; in shell/mod.rs). Parse i18n/<locale>/aliases/<environment>.toml ([[alias]] rows: surface, canonical, localisation_key?) via the toml crate into the AliasCatalogue (extended to carry the per-row optional key). Resolve the i18n/ root with i18n_bootstrap::resolve_i18n_root (make pub(crate) if needed). Load each environment's rows via apply_locale_overlay_keyed; a within-environment collision logs a WARN and retains the Identity_Base for that environment (Req 11.10), others still load.

Task 11.2 -- introduce a shell-owned LocaleAliasStore holding the overlaid AliasTable per environment name (at least FFCMD and FFEDIT) as a GROUPED sub-struct field on WorkbenchShell (not a flat field; wiring-standard.md). Populate it in crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/construct.rs (seed identity rows from Task 11.3 then apply the active locale's on-disk overlay). Re-populate it from the ui.locale reload path, extending the callback in main.rs / the construction seam, mirroring help.rs reload_help_registry_for_locale. Behaviour-neutral at en (no i18n/en/aliases required -> identity-only table).

Task 11.2 tests FIRST (alias_reader.rs #[cfg(test)]): reader_parses_toml_rows_into_catalogue with // Validates: localization Requirement 11.5 (temp aliases/FFEDIT.toml with one keyed + one plain row -> AliasCatalogue.rows_for carries both with key preserved; loading into ffedit_english makes the localised surface resolve to its root); reader_rejects_within_environment_collision_and_retains_base with // Validates: localization Requirement 11.10 (a surface mapping to two roots is rejected and the base table unchanged).

Task 11.3 -- when building a per-environment AliasTable for the store, SEED an identity row (surface==canonical, localisation_key=None) for every root command BEFORE applying the on-disk overlay. Add AliasTable::identity_for(roots: &[&str]). FFEDIT roots = the ffedit_english canonical verbs; FFCMD roots = the built-in menu-option root commands (from DEFAULT_*_TOML) plus registered root verbs (cmd_registry/command_store). An authored/overlaid row for the SAME canonical REPLACES the synthesised default (the Russian-root/English-surface case: overlay row surface=FIND, canonical=<russian-root>, key=verb-find leaves the root unchanged).

Task 11.3 tests FIRST: synthesised_identity_row_exists_for_every_root with // Validates: localization Requirement 11.3 (identity_for([CATALOGS,FILES,SETTINGS]) -> each resolves to itself); overlay_row_replaces_synthesised_default_without_changing_root with // Validates: localization Requirement 11.4 (seed root NAYTI; apply en overlay row (FIND, NAYTI, verb-find); canonical_verb(FIND)==Some(NAYTI), NAYTI still self-resolves, display surface for the row is t(verb-find)). Ensure a row whose surface matches an existing identity but keeps/sets a compatible canonical UPDATES rather than erroring (not a collision).

IMPLEMENTATION SUMMARY (all in crates/ff-desktop/src/):

1) Task 11.1 -- shell/environment.rs: AliasTable.entries changed from Vec<(String,String)> to Vec<AliasEntry>. NEW public(crate) struct `AliasEntry { surface: String, canonical: String, localisation_key: Option<String> }` (derives Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq). Method `AliasEntry::display_surface(&self) -> String` returns ff_i18n::t(key) when localisation_key is Some, else the raw surface (Req 11.1, 11.2). ffedit_english() builds AliasEntry with localisation_key=None (en byte-identical). canonical_verb unchanged in behaviour (now matches on e.surface/e.canonical). AliasTable now derives #[derive(Debug, Clone)].

2) keyed overlay -- shell/environment.rs: apply_locale_overlay(env, &[(String,String)]) is now a thin SHIM that maps each row to (s,c,None) and delegates to the NEW `apply_locale_overlay_keyed(&mut self, environment_name: &str, rows: &[alias_overlay::KeyedAliasRow]) -> Result<(), AliasOverlayError>`. Both share ONE scratch-copy collision discipline. Semantics: an incoming surface already resident with the SAME canonical UPDATES that row in place (moved to FRONT, key applied) -- this is the Req 11.4 overlay-replaces-synthesised-default behaviour and is NOT a collision; a DIFFERENT canonical is a collision (Err, base retained, Req 11.10). New rows are inserted at FRONT so an overlaid row's display surface is preferred by display_surface_for_canonical.

3) Task 11.3 -- shell/environment.rs: NEW `AliasTable::identity_for(roots: &[&str]) -> Self` seeds an identity AliasEntry (surface==canonical, key=None) per root, deduped case-insensitively (Req 11.3). NEW `AliasTable::display_surface_for_canonical(&self, canonical: &str) -> Option<String>` (the menu-render DISPLAY reader, FEAT-002 consumer; marked #[allow(dead_code)] ahead-of-consumer). NEW `AliasTable::canonical_verbs_owned(&self) -> Vec<String>` (distinct roots in first-seen order; used by the store reload to re-seed with the same roots).

4) CONTRACT SPLIT (400-line rule) -- environment.rs exceeded 400 non-test lines after the growth, so the CommandEnvironment trait + EnvDispatchOutcome enum were MOVED verbatim to NEW shell/environment_contract.rs and RE-EXPORTED from environment.rs via `pub(crate) use super::environment_contract::{CommandEnvironment, EnvDispatchOutcome};`. Every existing `super::environment::CommandEnvironment` / `crate::shell::environment::EnvDispatchOutcome` path is unchanged. `mod environment_contract;` registered in shell/mod.rs. environment.rs now ~370 total lines (test module starts ~line 372), under 400 non-test.

5) Task 11.2 reader + store -- NEW shell/alias_reader.rs (module `pub(crate) mod alias_reader;` in shell/mod.rs; whole module has #![allow(dead_code)] for the FEAT-002 consumers). Contents:
   - parse_alias_toml(text) -> Vec<KeyedAliasRow>: serde Deserialize of [[alias]] rows (surface, canonical, localisation_key?), surface+canonical UPPERCASED, empty key filtered to None.
   - read_catalogue_from_dir(aliases_dir, environments) -> AliasCatalogue: reads <aliases_dir>/<env>.toml per environment; missing file = no rows (not an error); malformed = WARN + skip.
   - builtin_ffcmd_roots() -> Vec<String>: distinct option.command values (UPPERCASED) from defaults::recovery_pom_menu() + recovery_settings_menu() -- the FFCMD seed roots (Req 11.3).
   - struct LocaleAliasStore (THE TYPE FEAT-002 NEEDS; derives Debug, Default): field `tables: Vec<(String, AliasTable)>` keyed by environment name. Methods: seed(ffcmd_roots: &[&str]) -> Self (FFEDIT = AliasTable::ffedit_english(); FFCMD = AliasTable::identity_for(ffcmd_roots)); seed_and_overlay_for_locale(ffcmd_roots: &[&str], locale: &str) -> Self (seed then overlay from resolve_i18n_root()/<locale>/aliases); apply_overlay_from_dir(&mut self, aliases_dir: &Path); table_for(&self, environment_name: &str) -> Option<&AliasTable> (THE KEYED-OVERLAY READER ENTRY POINT the resolver reads); ffcmd_roots(&self) (reads back seeded roots for reload).
   - process-global slot `static ACTIVE_ALIAS_STORE: Mutex<Option<Arc<Mutex<LocaleAliasStore>>>>` + publish_active_alias_store(&Arc<Mutex<LocaleAliasStore>>) + reload_active_alias_store_for_locale(locale: &str) -- mirrors help.rs ACTIVE_HELP_REGISTRY exactly.

6) AliasCatalogue extension -- shell/alias_overlay.rs: added `per_environment_keyed: Vec<(String, Vec<KeyedAliasRow>)>` + with_environment_keyed() + keyed_rows_for() + load_into_keyed() (loads via apply_locale_overlay_keyed). The pre-CR-NR-109 keyless API (per_environment, with_environment, rows_for, load_into) is UNCHANGED, so its existing tests are untouched. NEW public type alias `pub(crate) type KeyedAliasRow = (String, String, Option<String>);` (introduced to fix a clippy::type_complexity error) is the canonical keyed-row type threaded through environment.rs, alias_overlay.rs, alias_reader.rs.

7) SHELL WIRING -- grouped sub-struct `I18nState { pub alias_store: Arc<Mutex<LocaleAliasStore>> }` added to shell/state_groups.rs (derives Debug, Default; field #[allow(dead_code)] ahead-of-consumer). Field `i18n: state_groups::I18nState` added to WorkbenchShell in shell/state.rs (#[allow(dead_code)] ahead-of-consumer). shell/construct.rs seeds `LocaleAliasStore::seed_and_overlay_for_locale(builtin_ffcmd_roots(), help_locale)`, wraps in Arc<Mutex<..>>, calls publish_active_alias_store(&shared), and sets `i18n: I18nState { alias_store: locale_alias_store }`. main.rs ui.locale reload closure now also calls `shell::alias_reader::reload_active_alias_store_for_locale(&help_locale)` right after the help reload (same existing on_locale_reload seam -- no new mechanism). i18n_bootstrap::resolve_i18n_root was already pub(crate); no visibility change needed.
